title_sq: APARTAMENT 1+1 PER SHITJE TE PORTA TIRANA E RE !
description_sq:
Ne autostraden Tirane - Teg ne kompleksin rezidencial ''Porta Tirana e Re'' ofrohet apartament 1+1 per shitje.
Apartamenti eshte spacioz me sip. totale 85 m2 dhe siperfaqe neto 72.29 ndodhet ne katin e dyte ne nje ndertimi te 2026 drejte perfundimit.
Organizimi i apartamentit ndahet ne: korridor, dhome gjumi, sallon ndenje me ambient gatimi, tualet, dy ballkone.
Apartamenti eshte nje mundesi ideale banimi dhe investimi pasi kompleksi ofron shume fasilitete te ndryshme.
title_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN PORTA, NEW TIRANA!
description_en: On the Tirana - Teg highway in the "Porta Tirana e Re" residential complex, a 1+1 apartment is offered for sale. The apartment is spacious with total 85 m2 and net area 72.29 is located on the second floor in a building of 2026 towards completion. The organization of the apartment is divided into: corridor, bedroom, living room with kitchen, toilet, two balconies. The apartment is an ideal housing and investment opportunity as the complex offers many different facilities.
